clips.title: The story
paras: Taragaman the Hungerer is a hulking felguard lurking within the molten caverns of Ragefire Chasm beneath Orgrimmar. While widely feared as the demonic master behind the Searing Blade cult, his presence in the fiery depths serves a darker, more deceptive purpose. The Horde seeks his destruction to eliminate the demonic taint poisoning the city's underbelly.

Prowling amidst the magma pools of Ragefire Chasm, Taragaman the Hungerer represents an immediate and terrifying threat to the safety of Orgrimmar. For many scouts and young warriors sent into the dark chasm, the demonic felguard appears to be the central ringleader of the Searing Blade cultists, wielding infernal strength to bend the weak-willed and corrupt the subterranean passages beneath Thrall's fortress.
